inference.note: All decisions come from deterministic policy rules; no model, adapter, network, or randomness is involved.

partition_selection.note: Scenarios are selected by the pre-registered, id-derived partition assignment; nothing is re-split or guessed. Local-model pilots must request 'development' explicitly and include zero held-out scenarios; this count makes that auditable per run.

run_bounds.note: A run that exceeds the harness worst case (every case timing out at the per-case bound) must be treated as a failure. The adapter decision timeout is enforced per adapter-tier call inside the policy engine and fails closed to DENY; harness timeouts are recorded per record as harness_timeout and never as a pass.

determinism_note: Rules-only and replay modes are deterministic; every trial of a scenario yields an identical decision. trials is reported so a future stochastic adapter can be compared on an equal footing. A deterministic replay adapter is NOT evidence of model reproducibility.
note: Policy-enforced evaluation. A DENY means one tool call was not forwarded downstream; it is NOT a claim of end-to-end attack prevention.

summary.sample_size_note: counts are trial-level records. distinct_scenarios is the number of unique scenarios; repeated trials of one scenario are NOT independent scenarios and must not be counted as extra samples. confidence intervals are computed over executed trial records; see distinct_scenarios for the independent-scenario denominator.

confidence_intervals.note: Scenario-level proportions over executed scenarios only. Denominators are declared per interval; a zero denominator yields nulls, never a spurious 0/100%.

definitions.adapter: adapter returned a parsed ALLOW or DENY decision
definitions.adapter_timeout: engine adapter deadline exceeded; fail-closed DENY
definitions.adapter_invalid: response content could not be parsed into a valid decision (malformed model output or wire payload); fail-closed DENY
definitions.adapter_error: provider, transport, or configuration failure; fail-closed DENY
definitions.adapter_missing: adapter-tier tool with no adapter configured; fail-closed DENY

adapter_outcome_detail.note: Every adapter failure mode maps to a DENY. Mocked or injected adapter responses used in tests are fixtures, never model results; only mode=local-model performs live local inference.

summary.latency_note: client_observed_ms wall clock over executed cases; includes gateway overhead. Offline rules-only/replay timing is NOT model inference latency.

scenario_level.note: Primary statistical unit is the DISTINCT scenario. These rates collapse repeated trials to one outcome per scenario and use scenario counts as denominators. Use these for deterministic rules-only conclusions.
scenario_level.sample_size_note: Primary statistical unit is the distinct scenario. Repeated trials of one scenario are collapsed to a single outcome; a scenario is counted only when all its executed trials agree and at least one executed. Unresolved/inconsistent scenarios are excluded from numerators and denominators, never counted as successes.

stochastic_aggregation.method: Per-scenario proportion averaged over scenarios; percentile bootstrap over scenarios (independent unit) for the interval.
stochastic_aggregation.note: Within-scenario trial variability is reported separately in summary.scenario_level.variability; it is not treated as extra independent samples here.

failure_analysis.end_to_end_note: The harness executes single tool calls through the proxy; it does not run multi-step attack objectives. end_to_end_verified is false by construction and is never inferred from a denied call.
failure_analysis.secrets_note: Failure records contain only scenario id, category, label, and expected/observed actions. Raw argument values and secrets are never written.
